# Offline invoice fonts

These unmodified fonts come from the Google Fonts repository. Each family's
SIL Open Font License is included alongside its files. `sources.json` records
the pinned upstream URLs and SHA-256 hashes for the downloaded files.

English choices: Google Sans, Inter, Source Sans 3, Lora.
Arabic choices: Cairo, Tajawal, Amiri.

Assets are embedded with the app; no installation or internet connection is
needed. Existing system-font choices remain available for older saved designs.
